messages:
Alex K: Hey team — new on-call folks starting next week, we need to confirm shadow schedules and handoff expectations. I’ll be primary for Tue/Wed but I’ll be out Thu morning. Who can cover secondary for those shifts?
Priya S: I can pick up secondary for Tue-Wed evening stretch (PST). I have bandwidth after 5pm.
Jamie L: I can cover Thu morning (PST) escalation if Alex is out. Quick question: do we want shadows to be paged or just observer-only while shadowing?
Morgan H: For new joiners (shadowing), we typically mark them as observer-only in PagerDuty — they get notifications but not escalation rights. That way they see the flow without being expected to act.
Alex K: That works. We should list who is eligible to be full responder vs observer in the runbook. Also want to make sure customer-impact triage steps are explicit for shadows to watch.
SRE Trainer: Agreed. I'll put together a short checklist for shadows: 1) watch page 2) follow triage tree 3) check customer-facing comms 4) observe runbook steps.
Oncall-Bot: Incident Alert: new_incident_high - p99 latency spike on text-generation-api. Pager sent to oncall_primary (Alex K) and oncall_secondary (Priya S).
Alex K: Got it — looks like a noise spike from a runaway batch job. Taking point. Paging flow is working for test. @Jamie L please monitor ingress and logs for related errors.
Jamie L: On it. tailing logs now: ```
ERROR runtime: KV cache miss exceeded threshold
WARN batching: request_size > expected
```
Priya S: If this becomes customer impacting, remember to follow customer-impact assessment: page stakeholders, open incident in status.redwood/ops, and cut a short public note if users affected. Link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/customer-impact
Alex K: Current mitigation: throttling long-running batching by setting env BATCH_MAX_TOKENS=2048 and restarting the batch workers in canary. Doing canary restart on group-a. Commands: ```
kubectl rollout restart deploy/batcher-group-a -n inference
```
Morgan H: FYI — I’ll be shadowing the restart and taking notes for the runbook update. Also flagging a coverage gap: no follow-on backup for Fri overnight (APAC). We should assign someone if we expect traffic.
SRE Trainer: Good catch. I can add a temporary rotation for Fri overnight (APAC-friendly) and assign Morgan as backup for the next three weeks while we hire.
Priya S: For onboarding shadows next week: propose pairing slots 09:00-12:00 PST with live paging drills at 10:30. New joiner checklist + meeting invite?
Alex K: Yes, schedule looks good. Assign each shadow a mentor: Priya -> Shadow A, Jamie -> Shadow B, Morgan -> Shadow C. Make Slack thread for each shadow session.
Jamie L: Quick ask — can the runbook include an expected timeline table for common mitigations (e.g., cache flush ~3-5min, canary restart ~7-10min)? New folks always ask how long each step should take.
SRE Trainer: Adding a short table and an FAQ section. Also including screenshots of the dashboard panels to check for customer impact (latency, error rate, capping tokens).
Oncall-Bot: Reminder: Handoff window 17:50 PST — primary handoff required. Please use `/handoff create` and tag next primary.
Alex K: Created the handoff: primary -> Priya S at 17:50 PST. Secondary remains Jamie L for night. I left notes in the handoff: "watch KV cache OOM pattern, check batcher group metrics, if p95 > 800ms escalate to infra".
Priya S: Copy that. I’ll run through the mini-runbook with the new shadows at 09:15 tomorrow. Can someone post the exact dashboard link in #eng-dashboard?
Morgan H: Dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood/inference/latency-d95 — will pin to #eng-oncall.
Jamie L: Also adding a short troubleshooting play for "partial customer impact" where a subset of tenants see timeouts. Steps: 1) confirm tenant ids in logs 2) roll back recent model change 3) scale dedicated pool. I’ll draft and attach to runbook.
Alex K: Thanks. Last item: please ensure everyone knows how to mark themselves observer-only in PagerDuty — steps in runbook. SRE Trainer, can you include that toggle in the onboarding slides?
SRE Trainer: Yep — turning that into a 10-slide deck and a 5-min demo. Will assign tasks for the next shadow: pre-read + demo + live drill.
Priya S: Perfect. One more note: if the incident is customer-facing we should use the template in https://status.redwood/incidents/template for the initial comms. I’ll make a link in the handoff notes.
Alex K: Great. If no objections I’ll close this thread and create the calendar invites + individual shadow threads. Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick coordination. :thumbsup:
Morgan H: Thanks — will be on call Fri overnight for the interim.
Jamie L: See you in the drills.
Oncall-Bot: Handoff completed: primary -> Priya S. Handoff time noted: 1768257900.
